name: InnoLab Builder — Designing Corporate Innovation Engines
description: Design, launch, and defend a corporate innovation lab at Meridian Industrial Group. Make strategic decisions about mandate, operating model, staffing, funding, governance, and location, then manage a project pipeline while navigating corporate antibodies. Learn how organizational design shapes innovation outcomes.
